snippet.title: House Flipper: Party Furniture Pack -  Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello Flippers
It’s time for the party of the year! Grab your neons, drinks and get ready for the House Flipper Party Furniture Pack!🎉🎉🎉 
Feel the 80s vibe and groovy disco and take a look at our steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363170/House_Flipper__Party_Furniture_Pack/ 

Developed by Empyrean, Frozen Way
